Data Engineer I
Remote
Full Time
Entry Level
 SHARE

Role Summary 

The Data Engineer I develops, via using AI and SQL, and maintains robust data pipelines, manages data migrations and ETL processes, and delivers custom reporting solutions for Greenshades clients. This role combines deep technical expertise in data integration and file construction with hands-on compliance support for custom report deliverables. The Data Engineer I collaborates cross-functionally, manages work through an Azure DevOps Kanban board, and ensures data flows reliably across systems to meet both client and regulatory requirements. 

Responsibilities 

EDI 834 & Ancillary File Development: Build, test, and maintain EDI 834 benefit enrollment files and associated ancillary file formats, ensuring accuracy and compliance with carrier and trading partner specifications. 
Custom Reporting: Create custom reports and dashboards to provide actionable insights to internal and client stakeholders. Includes but not  limited to retirement reports, HSA and Benefit file feed creation, as well as WOTC, and related reports. 
Azure DevOps Kanban Management: Manage and track project work items using an Azure DevOps Kanban board, maintaining accurate status updates and prioritization throughout the project lifecycle. 
Collaboration: Work closely with clients and internal teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions that meet their needs. 
Security and Compliance: Ensure data security and adherence to relevant regulations and industry best practices. 
Other duties as assigned. 

Requirements 

1 – 2 years experience with ETL and data migration processes in a SQL-focused role 
Proficiency in T-SQL and SQL Server Management Studio (SQL Server 2012+, SSRS, SSIS) 
Hands-on experience building or working with EDI 834 files and ancillary benefit enrollment formats 
Experience managing work items and project tasks using Azure DevOps Kanban boards 
Strong proficiency in Excel and experience with object-oriented programming 
Experience with common scripting languages 
Familiarity with Oracle SQL*Plus is a plus 
Ability to communicate effectively between technical and non-technical stakeholders 
Experience with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence 
BS/BA in Computer Science or related field preferred 
Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and as part of a team 

This is a remote position.
